title: Portfolio Meeting Deck: 13-Slide Architecture & Leadership Walkthrough
description: Two-host architectural and leadership deep dive covering Ilteris Kaplan's 13-slide portfolio meeting deck. Spans 11 years at Google, 6 years in Cloud AI, 10 production systems, and the new Operating Principles slide covering Daily AI Workflow, Cross-Functional Triad, Conflict to Artifact, and Prioritizing Impact.
